task_summary: Research TON-specific stack: ton-settlement skill, verify.ts interface, SQLite WAL multi-process patterns, existing OpenClaw journal schema, acton-wallet FillResult/pending_reconcile flow. Provide concrete API signatures and integration points.
constraints: Multi-process Fly.io deployment (API, Scanner, Risk Gates, Executor)
TON blockchain with STON.fi/DeDust DEX routing
Append-only NDJSON journals + SQLite WAL for persistence
Settlement proof (99% delta) mandatory on every fill

options.name: Extend Current Stack (Recommended for Brownfield)
options.description: Incrementally integrate ton-settlement skill as async reconciler behind existing FillResult.pending_reconcile flow, using verify.ts helpers and SQLite WAL for position state machine
pros: Zero migration risk — leverages existing WalletAdapter/FillResult contract
verify.ts already provides computeDeliveredIncrement, readUserJettonBalance, verifyBuyDelivered, verifySellExecuted
SQLite WAL (busy_timeout=5000ms) already handles multi-process contention
Journal schema (positions, decision_journal, agentic_wallets) is stable
acton-wallet returns pending_reconcile with txHash — perfect settlement trigger
OrderQueueManager already separates HIGH (exits) vs NORMAL (buys) priority
cons: NDJSON journals not ACID — need PositionJournal for intermediate state
No existing background reconciler process — must add new process/worker
Idempotency keys for duplicate-exit prevention not yet implemented
risks: Medium: Journal folding latency (<2ms p99 target per hypothesis)
Low: SQLite WAL contention under high concurrent writes (mitigated by busy_timeout)
migration_path: 1. Add PositionJournal (NDJSON per-position or partitioned) in exit-manager
2. Implement PositionStateMachine returning TransitionIntent (not mutating Position)
3. Wire ton-settlement skill as async background reconciler polling fillsJournal
4. Add SETTLED event only on proven: true; P&L booked only on SETTLED
5. Add reconstructPosition(tokenAddress) folding journal from OPEN → latest
6. Add idempotencyKey = hash(tokenAddress, fromVersion, action, exitPrice) to prevent duplicate sells

verifyBuyDelivered({client, master, walletAddress, expectedNano, balanceBefore, attempts?, delayMs?}): Promise<{ok, error, actualBalance}>

verifySellDelta({balanceBefore, balanceAfter, soldNano}): {ok, error}
FillResult {status: 'filled'|'bounced'|'pending_reconcile', txHash, filledAmountTon, filledTokenQty, minOutTokenQty, slippageBps, mode, reason?}
swap(order: OrderRequest): Promise<FillResult> — returns pending_reconcile with txHash on broadcast success
WalletMutex sequential lock with seqno confirmation polling (20s timeout)
Multi-DEX routing: STON.fi direct, DeDust direct, USDT multi-hop (both DEXes)
WalletAdapter {name, swap(order): Promise<FillResult>}
PaperWallet (deterministic), TonMcpWallet (delegates to ActonWallet)
FillStatus = 'filled' | 'bounced' | 'pending_reconcile'
Workflow: pre-swap balance → poll post-swap → |delta-expected|/expected ≤ 99% → proven
Output: {proven: boolean, expected, actual, tolerance, txHash}
Unproven fills remain pending_reconcile, surfaced to operator
better-sqlite3 v11.6.0 with journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=5000ms
Tables: positions, daily_pnl, decision_journal, agentic_wallets
store.insert(table, row), store.query(table, where?, params?)
Journal.append(event), Journal.tail(max), Journal.lineCountValue
NDJSON files: signals-*, gated-*, orders-*, fills-*, positions-*
Rotation via maxBytes option
runContinuousExecutor({gatedDir, ordersOut, fillsOut, mode, pollIntervalMs, healthPort})
openPositionsMap restored from positionsJournal + ordersJournal
OrderQueueManager with HIGH/NORMAL priority, notifySlotAvailable()
Position stepping every 5s via stepPosition from exit-manager
stepPosition(pos, priceTon, now, candleClose?): StepResult {action, exitPriceTon, pos, reason, exitSizePct?}
ExitAction: hold | tp | sl | break_even | trail | time_stop | partial_tp | trend_reversal | momentum_reversal | ladder_exit | structure_sl | blocked
8-tier precedence: time_stop → ladder_exit → partial_tp → momentum_reversal → trend_reversal → break_even/trail → structure_sl → tp/sl

key_points: PositionStateMachine with versioned events: OPEN → PARTIAL_EXIT* → FULL_EXIT → SETTLED
Settlement-gated P&L: FULL_EXIT/PARTIAL_EXIT carry settlement: 'PENDING', SETTLED only on proven: true
Async settlement transition (chosen): queue moves on, background reconciler polls ton-settlement
7-layer pipeline: Scanner → Market Intel → Risk Gates → Order Queue → Execution → Exit Manager → Storage/API
Multi-process: API (3000), Scanner (8080), Risk Gates, Executor (8081)
SQLite WAL with busy_timeout=5000ms for zero-lock contention

selection_criteria: Must preserve existing WalletAdapter/FillResult contract (zero breaking changes)
Must use verify.ts helpers for on-chain balance delta proofs (fail-closed)
Must work with SQLite WAL multi-process deployment (no distributed consensus needed)
Must integrate with existing NDJSON journal rotation and tail() reads
Must support async settlement (queue never blocked on high-priority exits)
Must provide idempotency for crash-recovery duplicate-exit prevention

options.name: Dual-Write SQLite WAL + NDJSON (Alternative)
options.description: Use SQLite WAL as authoritative position store with ACID transactions for state transitions; NDJSON remains audit log
pros: ACID transactions coordinate exit decision + order enqueue + state update atomically
Eliminates need for idempotency keys and journal folding
better-sqlite3 already in use with WAL mode
cons: Schema migration required for PositionStateMachine tables
Dual-write complexity (must keep SQLite + NDJSON in sync)
Loss of pure append-only audit property for intermediate states
More invasive change than journal-first approach
risks: High: Transaction contention under concurrent executor + API writes
Medium: Schema evolution risk for financial state machine

options.name: Event Sourcing with Kafka/Redis Streams (Future Scale)
options.description: Replace NDJSON with durable log supporting consumer groups and exactly-once semantics
pros: Exactly-once semantics eliminate idempotency key complexity
cons: Infrastructure complexity (Kafka/Redis) not justified for single-node Fly.io
Breaks existing NDJSON tooling (tail, readJournal, grep)
risks: High: Premature optimization — current deployment doesn't need this
Medium: Migration cost from NDJSON → stream processing

ton_settlement_skill_invocation.trigger: FillResult with status='pending_reconcile' appended to fillsJournal
ton_settlement_skill_invocation.on_proven_true: Append SETTLED event to PositionJournal; book P&L in SQLite positions table
ton_settlement_skill_invocation.on_proven_false: Leave FULL_EXIT/PARTIAL_EXIT as settlement='PENDING'; surface to operator dashboard

verify_ts_integration.buy_verification: verifyBuyDelivered({client, master, walletAddress, expectedNano: order.minOutTokenQty * 10^decimals, balanceBefore: preBuyBalance, attempts: 5, delayMs: 1500})
verify_ts_integration.sell_verification: verifySellExecuted({client, master, walletAddress, soldNano: order.jettonAmountNano, balanceBefore: preSellBalance, attempts: 5, delayMs: 1500})

sqlite_wal_patterns.connection: Single Store instance per process (better-sqlite3 with WAL + busy_timeout=5000ms)
sqlite_wal_patterns.multi_process: Each Fly.io process (API, Executor, Coordinator) opens own connection to same agent.db
sqlite_wal_patterns.contention_handling: busy_timeout=5000ms + WAL allows concurrent readers + single writer
sqlite_wal_patterns.position_upsert: INSERT OR REPLACE INTO positions (id, wallet_tier, jetton_master, side, amount_ton, tx_hash, status, opened_at, closed_at, realized_pnl_ton, meta) VALUES (...)
sqlite_wal_patterns.decision_journal: INSERT INTO decision_journal (id, cycle_id, agent, input_hash, cap_check_result, final_action, output, created_at) VALUES (...)

journal_schema_extension.proposed_position_journal: position-{tokenAddress}.ndjson with events: OPEN(v1), PARTIAL_EXIT(vN), FULL_EXIT(vN), SETTLED(vN)

event_structure.PARTIAL_EXIT: {version: n, state: 'PARTIAL_EXIT', pos: PositionSnapshot, exit: {price, sizePct, action}, settlement: 'PENDING', ts, idempotencyKey}
event_structure.FULL_EXIT: {version: n, state: 'FULL_EXIT', pos: PositionSnapshot, exit: {price, action}, settlement: 'PENDING', ts, idempotencyKey}
event_structure.SETTLED: {version: n, state: 'SETTLED', pos: PositionSnapshot, settlement: {proven: true, txHash, actualQty, pnlTon}, ts}

acton_wallet_fillresult_flow.buy_order: ActonWallet.swap() → broadcast → returns {status: 'pending_reconcile', txHash, filledAmountTon, filledTokenQty: order.expectedTokenQty, ...}
acton_wallet_fillresult_flow.sell_order: ActonWallet.swap() → broadcast → returns {status: 'pending_reconcile', txHash, filledAmountTon, filledTokenQty: position.qty, ...}
acton_wallet_fillresult_flow.bounced: Returns {status: 'bounced', txHash: null, filledAmountTon: 0, filledTokenQty: 0, reason}
acton_wallet_fillresult_flow.reconciliation_trigger: fillsJournal.append({orderId, ...fillResult}) → ton-settlement picks up pending_reconcile entries

recommendation: Extend Current Stack (Option 1) — lowest risk, leverages all existing verified components, aligns with hypothesis.yaml async settlement transition design
